feature_board.title: Check in and out @ work
feature_board.text: WinProx Checkmate: the limited plan for clocking in and out on site. Cleaning now. CIAO included from the start.

employees.title: More convenience for your staff. Correct hours for your social secretariat.
employees.body: At home, your staff check their roster and registered hours and easily request leave or time off in lieu on their phone. At work, they use WinProx to clock in and to access the available features, such as issues, tasks and inspection rounds.
employees.note: The available features depend on your WinProx plan.
employees.image_alt: Worker checking roster and hours on a phone in WinProx.

clock.title: A small, elegant time clock for your business
clock.lead: WinProx Time: employees clock in and out with their own linked smartphone at the company's time clock. No app, no badge and no biometric identification.
items: Fixed clock screen with a rotating QR code
Time and attendance registration in WinProx
Extra protection against misuse, without biometric identification
Also works as a QR sticker, no screen needed
Compare the hours with the roster.
Pass the hours to your social secretariat.
clock.close: More control over who clocks in, when and where — without badges or biometric data.
